invalid.title: Verification failed
invalid.text: This document could not be authenticated. Its content may have been altered, or it may not have been issued by the Town Hall.

scan.title: Scan a document
scan.instructions: Point the camera at the QR code on the official certificate or document. Verification starts automatically.

scan.unrecognized: QR code not recognised: it does not contain a document identifier.
scan.manualHelp: Paste the identifier (UUID) or the full link printed on the document.
scan.manualError: Invalid identifier: it must look like xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.

about.title: Serving the people of Mahajanga, every day
about.intro: Capital of the Boeny region and a major port city in north-western Madagascar, Mahajanga is run by its Urban Municipality. The town hall is the institution closest to residents: it keeps civil records, plans the city, runs local services and looks after the well-being of the population.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To give every resident a local public service that is fast and fair, and to make Mahajanga a clean, safe, well-organised and forward-looking city. The Municipality acts under the authority of the Mayor and the Municipal Council, who vote the city's budget and decisions.

missions.title: What the town hall does
missions.intro: The main responsibilities of the Urban Municipality, carried out every day by its departments and desks.

items.title: Civil registry
items.text: Registering births, celebrating marriages, recording deaths and issuing copies and extracts of certificates.

items.title: Urban planning and land registry
items.text: Issuing building permits and alignments, and keeping the city plan and plot references.

items.title: Revenue and local taxes
items.text: Collecting property taxes, fees and charges that fund the city's services and facilities.

items.title: Markets and trade
items.text: Running municipal markets, allocating pitches and supporting traders.

items.title: Urban transport
items.text: Issuing taxi and taxi-be licences, and organising parking and traffic in the city.

items.title: Cleanliness and environment
items.text: Collecting waste and maintaining streets, green spaces and drainage channels.

items.title: Social action and community life
items.text: Supporting vulnerable families, public primary schools, basic health care, sport and culture.

items.title: Safety and public order
items.text: Keeping the peace with the municipal police and preventing risks (cyclones, floods, fires).

items.title: Orders and resolutions
items.text: Preparing, publishing and archiving the decisions of the Mayor and the Municipal Council, and issuing certified extracts.

goals.title: Our goals
goals.intro: What the Municipality is committed to improving for its residents.

items.title: Bring the town hall closer to citizens
items.text: Fewer queues and trips: everyday procedures can be started online, at any time.

items.title: More transparency
items.text: Every citizen can follow their request and gets a clear answer; issued documents can be verified by anyone.

items.title: Modernise the administration
items.text: Digitise registers and procedures to cut delays, limit errors and fight document fraud.

items.title: Develop the city
items.text: Improve roads, sanitation, street lighting and markets, and support economic and tourist activity.

items.title: Involve residents
items.text: Listen to suggestions and complaints from citizens and neighbourhoods (fokontany) to better guide municipal action.

items.title: Public service
items.text: A respectful welcome and the same service for everyone.

items.title: Fairness
items.text: Every request is handled in order and by the rules.

digital.title: The town hall online
digital.intro: This platform is the Municipality's digital front door. It lets you:
items: Request a certificate or a service from your phone or computer.
Follow the progress of your request and receive the town hall's reply.
Download the official documents issued by the desks.
Check that a document is authentic with its QR code and SHA-256 fingerprint.
